title: Lightly Smoked Argentinian Pepper Empanadas
description: A lacto-vegetarian friendly solo dinner dish featuring peppercorns and a bitter flavor profile, with a bouncy texture from the empanada dough.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine flour, smoked peppercorns, and a pinch of salt to make the empanada dough.
Gradually add in olive oil and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll each into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of chopped onion, a sprinkle of shredded mozzarella cheese, and a dash of ferment jang in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough in half to form a half moon shape and press the edges to seal.
Brush the tops with egg wash and cut a small slit in the top of each empanada.
Bake for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
